title: Northgate Tire Center Claims Bulletin — Road Hazard Credit Price by Wheel Replacement History
content:
# Road hazard credit price by wheel replacement history

**Rule.** The road hazard credit on a Northgate Tire Center package is worked on a price per tire — the price that is multiplied by the road hazard credit share — that depends on the replacement history of the damaged wheel position, the wheel position of the most recent road hazard replacement entry recorded on the package:

| Replacement history of the damaged wheel position | Price on which the road hazard credit is worked |
|---|---|
| a treadwear claim entry is recorded for that wheel position | the replacement tire charge booked against the latest such claim entry, less the treadwear credit booked against that same claim entry |
| no treadwear claim entry is recorded for that wheel position, and one or more road hazard replacement entries other than the current one are | the average net cost of those earlier replacements: the replacement tire charges booked on that wheel position, leaving out the one booked against the current replacement entry, less the road hazard credits booked on that wheel position, divided by the number of those earlier road hazard replacement entries |
| no earlier replacement is recorded on that wheel | the road hazard price paid per tire: the tire unit price on the package reduced by the per-unit price adjustments and per-unit mail-in rebates on the tires' purchase line for the tire item number (the unit price itself where there are none) |

**When the credit is fixed.** The road hazard credit on a tire fitted under a treadwear claim is fixed only after that claim's treadwear credit stands on the package. That is, for a wheel whose tire came from a treadwear claim, the road hazard credit is not fixed while that claim's treadwear credit does not yet stand on the package.

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

**Wheel refitted under a treadwear claim.** The latest treadwear claim entry on the wheel has a replacement tire charge of $170.00 booked against it and a treadwear credit of $42.50 booked against it. The price is 170.00 less 42.50, that is $127.50.

**Wheel replaced twice before under road hazard protection, never under a treadwear claim.** The wheel position shows replacement tire charges of $160.00 and $168.00 for the two earlier replacements, and $175.00 booked against the current replacement entry, which is left out. Road hazard credits of $120.00 and $90.00 stand on that wheel position. The earlier charges total $328.00; less the credits of $210.00 that leaves $118.00; divided by the 2 earlier replacement entries, the price is $59.00.

**Wheel never replaced.** A tire bought at $165.00 with a $5.00 per-unit mail-in rebate on the purchase line is worked on $160.00.
